messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We note your point regarding our delivery performance and are continuously working to improve it; our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We are open to extending the agreement to 24 months as you proposed, provided we include an AS-14404 index clause to manage material price volatility over that period. On this basis, we can offer a revised price of €5.51 per unit with 30 days payment terms. 

Our offer stands at a price of €5.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.51 per unit. As an alternative option: a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Option B: EUR 5.13 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.

As a dedicated partner offering an extensive stock range and reliable service, we always aim to find balanced solutions. Regarding your question, we consider a 0% deadband with base month 2026-08 to be the most fair and transparent approach for the index clause. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Furthermore, we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Therefore, we must maintain our offer of €5.46 per unit for a 24-month agreement with 90 days payment terms and the AS-14404 index clause. For full clarity, our offer consists of a price of €5.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH,

Thank you for your reply - we are disappointed that your price has hardly moved.

Our offers have moved 2.2% toward you since our first one; we now need a step from your side.

As it stands the offer is not acceptable to us; the options below show where we need to get to. We keep our offer as it stands.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.13 per unit, 24-month agreement, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net.
Option B: EUR 5.13 per unit, 36-month agreement, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net.

We hope you can take a real step so that we can close this together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing business with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. As there has been no further movement on your side, we must maintain our offer of EUR 5.46 for this package. 

Please consider this as our final offer (letztes Angebot). We kindly ask you to make your decision soon, and please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days. 

For your reference, our offer stands at a price of €5.46 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and includes a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We are prepared to review our position once you are able to take a step towards our price. 

We always value our relationship and our team remains dedicated to supplying your needs from our extensive stock. Please let us know how you wish to proceed.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
